diagnosis: When a user adds or removes an item from the bag, only the bag counter badge updates without contextual feedback announced or displayed for assistive technologies or users, leaving them unaware of what action succeeded.
repair_strategy: Import `toastActions` from `../store/toastSlice` into `HomeItem.jsx` and dispatch `toastActions.showToast(...)` with descriptive messages when items are added to or removed from the bag. The globally rendered Toast component handles aria-live and status roles automatically.
